svg.text: A computer that knows what you want before you ask, and keeps it on your machine.
The same in all four places. Each layer only talks to the one under it.
38 apps, each walled off, so one crash stays one crash
windows, dock, menu bar; Samantha runs what you type or say
takes turns between apps, stops a frozen one, files, network
screen, keyboard, mouse, mic, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, SD card, sound
a Raspberry Pi 4, a PC, or QEMU pretending to be one
Out on the internet: Turing (her brain), ElevenLabs (her voice), a Cloudflare Worker and Open-Meteo.
How an app gets onto the Pi (8.0)
Sealed apps run for anyone; unsealed ones (yours, or Samantha's) only for an admin; a broken seal never.
Checked on every pull request. The kernel is still C, built on a Mac.
The Pi, on the real board
Solid: seen working on the real board (2026-10-12, v3). Dashed: built and checked in QEMU, not yet seen there.
Drawn by tools/gen/map.py. The detail graphs live in docs/.
